name: obversa
description: A TypeScript workspace for gating real-world processes with review surfaces.
author: Jonny Neill <jonnyneill@hotmail.com>

scripts.example:packages: pnpm --filter @obversa/memory exec tsx ../../examples/packages/memory.ts && pnpm --filter @obversa/memory-simple exec tsx ../../examples/packages/memory-simple.ts && pnpm --filter @obversa/memory-git exec tsx ../../examples/packages/memory-git.ts
scripts.verify:d1: pnpm check:agent-instructions && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm test:boundaries && pnpm check:publish && pnpm test:publish-guard && pnpm test:agent-workflow && pnpm test:commit-policy && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:ts6 && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:packages && pnpm docs:validate && pnpm example:packages && pnpm example:offline && pnpm check:consumer
scripts.verify:d2: pnpm verify:d1 && pnpm test:graph-purity && pnpm check:graph-purity && pnpm example:graph
scripts.check:arrows: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json packages/lines/src packages/lines/tests packages/memory/src packages/memory/tests packages/memory-git/src packages/memory-git/tests packages/memory-simple/src packages/memory-simple/tests packages/source/src packages/source/test packages/source/assets packages/surfacer/src packages/surfacer/test packages/surfacer/examples hosts/cmux/lib hosts/cmux/test scripts examples
